name: Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)
excerpt: RTM lists requirements and tracks their fulfillment.
notes: The Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) is a table that lists requirements and various attributes, tracking how close the project is to meeting those requirements. It is a tool used in project scope management to ensure all requirements are met and verified.
context_summary:
- Lists requirements and various attributes.
- Tracks fulfillment of requirements.
- Ensures all requirements are met and verified.
